title: Inheritance and polymorphism working together
answer: Inheritance creates a subtype relationship and supplies the method contract that can be overridden; polymorphism allows code using the parent type to work with different child objects and receive child-specific overridden behavior at runtime. AeroTopo defines `Product.resolutionMetres()` abstractly and implements it differently in `Orthomosaic` and `Dem`. A Product reference can therefore represent either subtype while dynamic dispatch invokes the correct resolution implementation.
